english.notes:
(i) Section 179(6) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 provides that this offence may be charged by reference to any day or longer period of time and a person may be convicted of a second or subsequent offence under the subsection in question by reference to any period of time following the preceding conviction for such an offence.
(ii) For details of the complex time limit on prosecutions - see section 171B.
(iii) Section 179 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 is as substituted by section 8 of the Planning and Compensation Act 1991.
